verdict: Braze: Choose Braze when enterprise B2C multi-channel engagement (push/in-app/email/SMS) is the primary marketing job. Scores use the marketing-editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Strong scalability narrative for consumer brands
Credible peer to Marketo for engagement (different buyer job)
bestFor: Enterprise B2C brands orchestrating multi-channel engagement
Product-led companies comparing Customer.io at larger scale
Teams needing push/in-app/email orchestration with real-time data
notIdealFor: SMBs wanting published freemium ESP pricing
B2B MAP buyers whose center of gravity is Marketo/Pardot
tradeoffs: Specialist depth (listening vs scheduling vs funnels) vs all-in-one breadth
Published entry price vs contact/profile/mention upgrade pressure
Marketing automation / email depth vs pure ESP peers
recommendation: Choose Braze when enterprise B2C multi-channel engagement (push/in-app/email/SMS) is the primary marketing job. Compare Marketo for enterprise B2B MAP, Customer.io for mid-market event messaging, Klaviyo/Omnisend for ecommerce owned channels, and Buffer for social-only jobs.
